@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fira+Code:wght@300..700&family=Geist:wght@100..900&display=swap');
@tailwind base;
@tailwind components;
@tailwind utilities;

@layer base {
	:root {
		/* Overridden at runtime by `initTypography()` — `config.typography.fontFamily` */
		--font-sans: 'Geist', sans-serif;

		--background: #f8fafc;

		--foreground: 0 0% 3.9%;

		--card: 0 0% 100%;

		--card-foreground: 0 0% 3.9%;

		--popover: 0 0% 100%;

		--popover-foreground: 0 0% 3.9%;

		--primary: 0 0% 9%;

		--primary-foreground: 0 0% 98%;

		--secondary: 0 0% 96.1%;

		--secondary-foreground: 0 0% 9%;

		--muted: 0 0% 96.1%;

		--muted-foreground: '#64748B';

		--accent: 0 0% 96.1%;

		--accent-foreground: #f4f4f5;

		--destructive: 0 84.2% 60.2%;

		--destructive-foreground: 0 0% 98%;

		--border: 0 0% 89.8%;

		--input: 0 0% 89.8%;

		--ring: 0 0% 3.9%;

		--chart-1: 12 76% 61%;

		--chart-2: 173 58% 39%;

		--chart-3: 197 37% 24%;

		--chart-4: 43 74% 66%;

		--chart-5: 27 87% 67%;

		--radius: 6px;

		/* fp-tokens:begin light — generated by scripts/generate-theme-tokens.mjs, do not hand-edit */
		/* ------------------------------------------------------------------
		 * Dark-theme token layer (--fp-*). ADDITIVE ONLY.
		 *
		 * Every light value below is byte-identical to the Tailwind palette color it replaces,
		 * so migrating a component from e.g. `text-gray-500` to `text-content-muted` cannot
		 * change light mode. Enforced by scripts/verify-theme-tokens.mjs.
		 *
		 * Channels are space-separated RGB, consumed as `rgb(var(--fp-x) / <alpha-value>)` so
		 * Tailwind opacity modifiers (`/50`) keep working. Do not convert these to hex or HSL.
		 *
		 * Source of truth: scripts/theme-tokens.mjs. Regenerate with
		 * `node scripts/generate-theme-tokens.mjs`.
		 * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

		/* Surfaces — backgrounds. Midnight layers chrome (darkest) under panels (lighter). */
		--fp-surface: 255 255 255; /* #ffffff — bg-white — the elevated panel */
		--fp-surface-subtle: 249 250 251; /* #f9fafb — recessed wells, table headers, hover rows */
		--fp-surface-muted: 244 244 245; /* #f4f4f5 */
		--fp-surface-shell: 243 244 246; /* #f3f4f6 — app chrome behind every panel — darkest layer */
		--fp-surface-strong: 229 231 235; /* #e5e7eb */
		--fp-surface-heavy: 156 163 175; /* #9ca3af */
		--fp-surface-faint: 250 250 250; /* #fafafa */
		--fp-surface-canvas: 255 255 255; /* #ffffff — main content area — stays darker than surface */
		--fp-surface-cool: 248 250 252; /* #f8fafc */
		--fp-surface-inverse: 17 24 39; /* #111827 — dark-on-light chips invert */
		--fp-surface-inverse-zinc: 24 24 27; /* #18181b — inverted tooltips built on zinc rather than gray */
		--fp-surface-track: 229 229 229; /* #e5e5e5 — switch track when off — matches the original --input light value */
		--fp-surface-scrim: 0 0 0; /* #000000 — modal scrim — black in both themes */

		/* Content — text, icons, fills. The light ramp inverts to the Midnight text ramp. */
		--fp-content: 17 24 39; /* #111827 */
		--fp-content-heading: 31 41 55; /* #1f2937 */
		--fp-content-secondary: 55 65 81; /* #374151 */
		--fp-content-tertiary: 75 85 99; /* #4b5563 */
		--fp-content-muted: 107 114 128; /* #6b7280 — Linear secondary text */
		--fp-content-subtle: 156 163 175; /* #9ca3af — brightened from #6e727b — 3.25:1 failed AA on surface-subtle */
		--fp-content-disabled: 209 213 219; /* #d1d5db — deliberately low contrast (2.2:1) — disabled text is exempt from AA and must read as disabled */
		--fp-content-inverse: 255 255 255; /* #ffffff — text on a filled button — button goes light in dark mode */
		--fp-content-black: 0 0 0; /* #000000 */

		/* Content (zinc ramp) — exists only to keep light byte-identical. Collapsible later. */
		--fp-content-zinc: 9 9 11; /* #09090b */
		--fp-content-zinc-bold: 24 24 27; /* #18181b */
		--fp-content-zinc-strong: 39 39 42; /* #27272a */
		--fp-content-zinc-secondary: 63 63 70; /* #3f3f46 */
		--fp-content-zinc-tertiary: 82 82 91; /* #52525b */
		--fp-content-zinc-muted: 113 113 122; /* #71717a */
		--fp-content-zinc-disabled: 212 212 216; /* #d4d4d8 */
		--fp-content-zinc-subtle: 161 161 170; /* #a1a1aa — brightened from #6e727b — same AA failure as content-subtle */

		/* Content (slate ramp) — same rationale as the zinc ramp. */
		--fp-content-slate: 15 23 42; /* #0f172a */
		--fp-content-slate-strong: 30 41 59; /* #1e293b */
		--fp-content-slate-secondary: 51 65 85; /* #334155 */
		--fp-content-slate-tertiary: 71 85 105; /* #475569 */
		--fp-content-slate-muted: 100 116 139; /* #64748b */
		--fp-content-slate-subtle: 148 163 184; /* #94a3b8 — brightened from #74787f — 3.53:1 failed AA */
		--fp-content-slate-disabled: 203 213 225; /* #cbd5e1 — unselected step marker */

		/* Lines — borders, dividers, rings. Hairlines, not surfaces. */
		--fp-line: 229 231 235; /* #e5e7eb — the workhorse border */
		--fp-line-subtle: 243 244 246; /* #f3f4f6 */
		--fp-line-strong: 209 213 219; /* #d1d5db */
		--fp-line-bold: 156 163 175; /* #9ca3af */
		--fp-line-zinc: 228 228 231; /* #e4e4e7 */
		--fp-line-zinc-subtle: 244 244 245; /* #f4f4f5 */
		--fp-line-zinc-strong: 212 212 216; /* #d4d4d8 */
		--fp-line-slate: 226 232 240; /* #e2e8f0 */
		--fp-line-slate-subtle: 241 245 249; /* #f1f5f9 */
		--fp-line-slate-strong: 203 213 225; /* #cbd5e1 */
		--fp-line-inverse: 0 0 0; /* #000000 */

		/* Status — info (blue). Solids brighten; tinted backgrounds invert to dark tints. */
		--fp-info: 37 99 235; /* #2563eb */
		--fp-info-bright: 59 130 246; /* #3b82f6 */
		--fp-info-strong: 29 78 216; /* #1d4ed8 */
		--fp-info-deep: 30 64 175; /* #1e40af */
		--fp-info-deepest: 30 58 138; /* #1e3a8a */
		--fp-info-muted: 239 246 255; /* #eff6ff */
		--fp-info-muted-strong: 219 234 254; /* #dbeafe */
		--fp-info-line: 191 219 254; /* #bfdbfe */

		/* Status — danger (red). */
		--fp-danger: 220 38 38; /* #dc2626 */
		--fp-danger-bright: 239 68 68; /* #ef4444 */
		--fp-danger-soft: 248 113 113; /* #f87171 */
		--fp-danger-strong: 185 28 28; /* #b91c1c */
		--fp-danger-deep: 153 27 27; /* #991b1b */
		--fp-danger-muted: 254 242 242; /* #fef2f2 */
		--fp-danger-line: 254 202 202; /* #fecaca */

		/* Status — warning (amber) plus the orange/yellow one-offs. */
		--fp-warning: 217 119 6; /* #d97706 */
		--fp-warning-bright: 245 158 11; /* #f59e0b */
		--fp-warning-soft: 251 191 36; /* #fbbf24 */
		--fp-warning-strong: 180 83 9; /* #b45309 */
		--fp-warning-deep: 146 64 14; /* #92400e */
		--fp-warning-muted: 255 251 235; /* #fffbeb */
		--fp-warning-muted-strong: 254 243 199; /* #fef3c7 */
		--fp-warning-line: 253 230 138; /* #fde68a */
		--fp-warning-line-strong: 252 211 77; /* #fcd34d */
		--fp-warning-deepest: 120 53 15; /* #78350f */
		--fp-accent-orange: 234 88 12; /* #ea580c */
		--fp-accent-orange-muted: 255 237 213; /* #ffedd5 */
		--fp-accent-orange-bg: 255 247 237; /* #fff7ed */
		--fp-accent-yellow: 234 179 8; /* #eab308 */
		--fp-accent-yellow-mid: 202 138 4; /* #ca8a04 */
		--fp-accent-yellow-bg: 254 252 232; /* #fefce8 */
		--fp-accent-yellow-line: 250 204 21; /* #facc15 */
		--fp-accent-yellow-strong: 161 98 7; /* #a16207 */
		--fp-accent-yellow-deep: 113 63 18; /* #713f12 */

		/* Status — success (green / emerald). */
		--fp-success: 22 163 74; /* #16a34a */
		--fp-success-bright: 34 197 94; /* #22c55e */
		--fp-success-soft: 74 222 128; /* #4ade80 */
		--fp-success-strong: 21 128 61; /* #15803d */
		--fp-success-deep: 22 101 52; /* #166534 */
		--fp-success-deepest: 20 83 45; /* #14532d */
		--fp-success-line-subtle: 220 252 231; /* #dcfce7 */
		--fp-success-muted: 240 253 244; /* #f0fdf4 */
		--fp-success-line: 187 247 208; /* #bbf7d0 */
		--fp-accent-emerald: 16 185 129; /* #10b981 */
		--fp-accent-emerald-strong: 5 150 105; /* #059669 */
		--fp-accent-emerald-soft: 52 211 153; /* #34d399 */
		--fp-accent-emerald-deep: 4 120 87; /* #047857 */
		--fp-accent-emerald-muted: 209 250 229; /* #d1fae5 */
		--fp-accent-emerald-line: 167 243 208; /* #a7f3d0 */
		--fp-accent-emerald-bg: 236 253 245; /* #ecfdf5 */
		--fp-accent-teal: 20 184 166; /* #14b8a6 */
		--fp-accent-teal-deep: 13 148 136; /* #0d9488 */

		/* Accents — indigo / purple / sky / violet. */
		--fp-accent-indigo: 79 70 229; /* #4f46e5 */
		--fp-accent-indigo-strong: 67 56 202; /* #4338ca */
		--fp-accent-indigo-muted: 238 242 255; /* #eef2ff */
		--fp-accent-indigo-line: 199 210 254; /* #c7d2fe */
		--fp-accent-rose: 251 113 133; /* #fb7185 */
		--fp-accent-rose-line: 254 205 211; /* #fecdd3 */
		--fp-accent-rose-muted: 255 241 242; /* #fff1f2 */
		--fp-accent-purple: 147 51 234; /* #9333ea */
		--fp-accent-purple-muted: 250 245 255; /* #faf5ff */
		--fp-accent-purple-line: 243 232 255; /* #f3e8ff */
		--fp-accent-purple-deep: 88 28 135; /* #581c87 */
		--fp-accent-sky: 2 132 199; /* #0284c7 */
		--fp-accent-sky-bright: 14 165 233; /* #0ea5e9 */
		--fp-accent-violet: 124 58 237; /* #7c3aed */

		/* App shell — sidebar chrome and nav states. Light values are the exact hexes the shell already used. */
		--fp-surface-sidebar: 249 249 249; /* #f9f9f9 — sidebar canvas — darkest Midnight layer */
		--fp-surface-bold: 209 213 219; /* #d1d5db — sidebar resize rail */
		--fp-surface-selected: 228 228 231; /* #e4e4e7 — active nav item */
		--fp-surface-selected-alt: 237 237 237; /* #ededed — duplicate of surface-selected at a different light hex — collapsible later */
		--fp-line-faint: 186 186 186; /* #bababa — promo card hairline */
		--fp-content-slate-deep: 2 6 23; /* #020617 — active breadcrumb */
		--fp-brand-navy: 9 46 68; /* #092e44 — Flexprice navy — brightened so it reads on dark */
		--fp-brand-fill: 9 46 68; /* #092e44 — primary button fill */
		--fp-content-on-brand: 255 255 255; /* #ffffff — label on brand-fill — white in both themes */
		--fp-surface-notch: 212 212 216; /* #d4d4d8 — Card notch bar — zinc.300 as a fill, not a border */
		--fp-accent-yellow-muted: 254 240 138; /* #fef08a — Coming-soon badge fill */
		--fp-surface-avatar: 0 0 0; /* #000000 — tenant initials tile — inverts, unlike surface-scrim which stays black */

		/* Status chips + toasts. Applied through inline style, so these are consumed as rgb(var(--fp-x)). */
		--fp-chip-success-bg: 236 251 228; /* #ecfbe4 */
		--fp-chip-success-text: 55 126 106; /* #377e6a */
		--fp-chip-success-line: 209 233 202; /* #d1e9ca */
		--fp-chip-neutral-bg: 240 242 245; /* #f0f2f5 */
		--fp-chip-neutral-text: 87 100 110; /* #57646e */
		--fp-chip-danger-bg: 254 226 226; /* #fee2e2 — chip danger text reuses the existing `danger` token (red.600) */
		--fp-chip-info-bg: 239 248 255; /* #eff8ff */
		--fp-chip-info-text: 47 111 226; /* #2f6fe2 */
		--fp-chip-warning-bg: 255 247 237; /* #fff7ed */
		--fp-chip-warning-text: 194 65 12; /* #c2410c */
		--fp-toast-success: 92 167 160; /* #5ca7a0 — react-hot-toast iconTheme.primary */
		--fp-toast-danger: 231 110 80; /* #e76e50 */
		--fp-line-zinc-bold: 161 161 170; /* #a1a1aa — InfoIcon focus ring */
		--fp-line-zinc-tertiary: 82 82 91; /* #52525b — RadioGroup selected border */
		--fp-surface-slate-subtle: 241 245 249; /* #f1f5f9 — MultiChipInput chip fill */
		--fp-stepper-active: 51 51 51; /* #333333 — Stepper active/completed step */
		--fp-stepper-idle: 153 153 153; /* #999999 */
		--fp-stepper-line: 235 235 235; /* #ebebeb */

		/* Environment badge — sandbox/production pill in the sidebar. Gradient stops are applied via inline style. */
		--fp-env-dev-bg: 255 252 238; /* #fffcee — gradient edge */
		--fp-env-dev-bg-mid: 255 249 221; /* #fff9dd — gradient centre */
		--fp-env-prod-bg: 238 244 255; /* #eef4ff — gradient edge */
		--fp-env-prod-bg-mid: 221 231 255; /* #dde7ff — gradient centre */
		--fp-env-prod-line: 191 208 245; /* #bfd0f5 */
		--fp-env-prod-text: 31 90 218; /* #1f5ada */

		/* Auth / banner surfaces — inline gradients and avatar tiles that must invert with their text. */
		--fp-banner-bg: 247 247 247; /* #f7f7f7 — Slack banner gradient edge */
		--fp-banner-bg-mid: 237 237 237; /* #ededed — Slack banner gradient centre */
		--fp-surface-avatar-navy: 11 17 33; /* #0b1121 — org initials tile — inverts with content-inverse */

		/* Restricted-environment banner — full-width inline gradients that must move with their text. */
		--fp-banner-info-line: 227 236 255; /* #e3ecff */
		--fp-banner-info-text: 24 79 199; /* #184fc7 */
		--fp-banner-danger-bg: 255 238 238; /* #ffeeee — gradient edge */
		--fp-banner-danger-bg-mid: 255 234 234; /* #ffeaea — gradient centre */
		--fp-banner-danger-line: 255 221 221; /* #ffdddd */
		--fp-banner-danger-text: 200 27 27; /* #c81b1b */

		/* Charts — axis, grid and series colours applied through Recharts props and inline style. */
		--fp-chart-axis: 204 204 204; /* #cccccc — axis line */
		--fp-chart-grid: 240 240 240; /* #f0f0f0 — cartesian grid */
		--fp-accent-indigo-bright: 99 102 241; /* #6366f1 — series colour */

		/* Off-palette values that predate the token layer — greys and accents written as arbitrary hex. */
		--fp-surface-panel: 251 251 251; /* #fbfbfb — filter popovers */
		--fp-surface-panel-alt: 252 252 252; /* #fcfcfc — tutorial card gradient end */
		--fp-surface-thumb: 245 245 245; /* #f5f5f5 — tutorial card thumbnail well */
		--fp-surface-thumb-alt: 244 244 244; /* #f4f4f4 */
		--fp-surface-faint-inner: 249 249 249; /* #f9f9f9 — redundant fill inside surface-faint — must vanish */
		--fp-surface-thumb-inner: 243 244 246; /* #f3f4f6 — img placeholder inside surface-thumb — must vanish */
		--fp-surface-cool-strong: 221 225 235; /* #dde1eb */
		--fp-line-hairline: 233 233 233; /* #e9e9e9 — empty-state card border */
		--fp-line-muted: 207 207 207; /* #cfcfcf */
		--fp-line-slate-deep: 15 23 42; /* #0f172a — selected radio outline */
		--fp-content-grey: 94 94 94; /* #5e5e5e */
		--fp-accent-teal-brand: 42 157 144; /* #2a9d90 */
		--fp-accent-yellow-brand: 245 197 11; /* #f5c50b */
		--fp-accent-indigo-soft: 97 103 217; /* #6167d9 */
		--fp-accent-amber-soft: 255 191 118; /* #ffbf76 */
		--fp-accent-blue-deep: 14 90 201; /* #0e5ac9 */
		--fp-accent-amber-mid: 197 142 32; /* #c58e20 */

		/* Subscription-type chips — teal / violet / indigo triples applied through Chip props. */
		--fp-chip-teal-bg: 204 251 241; /* #ccfbf1 */
		--fp-chip-teal-text: 15 118 110; /* #0f766e */
		--fp-chip-teal-line: 153 246 228; /* #99f6e4 */
		--fp-chip-violet-bg: 245 243 255; /* #f5f3ff */
		--fp-chip-violet-text: 109 40 217; /* #6d28d9 */
		--fp-chip-violet-line: 221 214 254; /* #ddd6fe */
		--fp-chip-indigo-bg: 238 242 255; /* #eef2ff */
		--fp-chip-indigo-text: 67 56 202; /* #4338ca */
		--fp-chip-indigo-line: 224 231 255; /* #e0e7ff */
		--fp-chip-type-static-bg: 243 244 246; /* #f3f4f6 */
		--fp-chip-type-static-text: 75 85 99; /* #4b5563 */
		--fp-chip-type-metered-bg: 219 234 254; /* #dbeafe */
		--fp-chip-type-metered-text: 30 64 175; /* #1e40af */
		--fp-chip-type-boolean-bg: 220 252 231; /* #dcfce7 */
		--fp-chip-type-boolean-text: 22 101 52; /* #166534 */
		--fp-chip-type-config-bg: 245 243 255; /* #f5f3ff */
		--fp-chip-type-config-text: 91 33 182; /* #5b21b6 */
		--fp-chip-type-default-bg: 249 250 251; /* #f9fafb */
		--fp-chip-type-default-text: 107 114 128; /* #6b7280 */

		/* Brand blue — pre-existing literals from tailwind.config.js, now themable. Light unchanged. */
		--fp-brand-blue: 50 147 217; /* #3293d9 — was colors.blue.DEFAULT */
		--fp-brand-blue-light: 229 240 255; /* #e5f0ff — was colors.blue.light */
		/* fp-tokens:end light */
	}
	.dark {
		--background: 0 0% 7.5%; /* #131313 — matches --fp-surface-canvas */

		--foreground: 220 9.7% 93.9%; /* #eeeff1 — matches --fp-content */

		--card: 0 0% 9.4%; /* #181818 — elevated panel — matches --fp-surface */

		--card-foreground: 220 9.7% 93.9%; /* #eeeff1 */

		--popover: 240 4.1% 14.3%; /* #232326 — floats above surface #181818; matches --fp-surface-subtle */

		--popover-foreground: 220 9.7% 93.9%; /* #eeeff1 */

		--primary: 202.1 72.3% 36.9%; /* #1a70a2 — brand blue fill in dark */

		--primary-foreground: 0 0% 100%; /* #ffffff — near-black on #1a70a2 is 3.54:1, so the label goes white (5.41:1) */

		--secondary: 240 5.2% 19%; /* #2e2e33 — matches --fp-surface-strong */

		--secondary-foreground: 220 9.7% 93.9%; /* #eeeff1 */

		--muted: 240 4.1% 14.3%; /* #232326 — matches --fp-surface-subtle */

		--muted-foreground: 218.6 6.4% 56.9%; /* #8a8f98 — matches --fp-content-muted */

		--accent: 240 3.9% 15.1%; /* #252528 — hover surface */

		--accent-foreground: 220 9.7% 93.9%; /* #eeeff1 */

		--destructive: 358.1 85.8% 64.1%; /* #f2555a — matches --fp-danger; used as text 52x vs bg 19x, so it must read on dark */

		--destructive-foreground: 240 3.2% 6.1%; /* #0f0f10 — dark text on the bright red fill — 7.5:1 */

		--border: 240 5.7% 17.1%; /* #29292e — matches --fp-line */

		--input: 240 5.4% 22%; /* #35353b — matches --fp-line-strong */

		--ring: 221.5 5.6% 45.7%; /* #6e727b — neutral focus ring — no coloured selection box */

		--chart-1: 220 70% 50%;

		--chart-2: 160 60% 45%;

		--chart-3: 30 80% 55%;

		--chart-4: 280 65% 60%;

		--chart-5: 340 75% 55%;

		/* Sidebar chrome. tailwind.config.js references these but no CSS ever defined them, so
		 * `bg-sidebar` paints transparent in light mode. Defining them here only — never in :root —
		 * leaves light exactly as it is today and gives dark its Midnight chrome. */
		--sidebar-background: 240 3.2% 6.1%; /* #0f0f10 — darkest layer — the app chrome */
		--sidebar-foreground: 222.9 8% 82.9%; /* #d0d2d7 */
		--sidebar-primary: 220 9.7% 93.9%; /* #eeeff1 */
		--sidebar-primary-foreground: 240 3.2% 6.1%; /* #0f0f10 */
		--sidebar-accent: 0 0% 9.4%; /* #181818 — selected / hovered nav item */
		--sidebar-accent-foreground: 220 9.7% 93.9%; /* #eeeff1 */
		--sidebar-border: 240 5.7% 17.1%; /* #29292e */
		--sidebar-ring: 221.5 5.6% 45.7%; /* #6e727b */

		/* fp-tokens:begin dark — generated by scripts/generate-theme-tokens.mjs, do not hand-edit */
		/* ------------------------------------------------------------------
		 * Dark-theme token layer — Linear "Midnight" values.
		 * Source of truth: scripts/theme-tokens.mjs.
		 * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

		/* Surfaces — backgrounds. Midnight layers chrome (darkest) under panels (lighter). */
		--fp-surface: 24 24 24; /* #181818 */
		--fp-surface-subtle: 35 35 38; /* #232326 */
		--fp-surface-muted: 37 37 40; /* #252528 */
		--fp-surface-shell: 15 15 16; /* #0f0f10 */
		--fp-surface-strong: 46 46 51; /* #2e2e33 */
		--fp-surface-heavy: 79 79 87; /* #4f4f57 */
		--fp-surface-faint: 31 31 34; /* #1f1f22 — recessed / hover well (slightly above surface) */
		--fp-surface-canvas: 19 19 19; /* #131313 */
		--fp-surface-cool: 26 26 29; /* #1a1a1d */
		--fp-surface-inverse: 238 239 241; /* #eeeff1 */
		--fp-surface-inverse-zinc: 238 239 241; /* #eeeff1 */
		--fp-surface-track: 232 232 234; /* #e8e8ea — switch track when off (light track on dark UI) */
		--fp-surface-scrim: 0 0 0; /* #000000 */

		/* Content — text, icons, fills. The light ramp inverts to the Midnight text ramp. */
		--fp-content: 238 239 241; /* #eeeff1 */
		--fp-content-heading: 228 229 232; /* #e4e5e8 */
		--fp-content-secondary: 208 210 215; /* #d0d2d7 */
		--fp-content-tertiary: 169 173 182; /* #a9adb6 */
		--fp-content-muted: 138 143 152; /* #8a8f98 */
		--fp-content-subtle: 135 140 149; /* #878c95 */
		--fp-content-disabled: 85 88 95; /* #55585f */
		--fp-content-inverse: 15 15 16; /* #0f0f10 */
		--fp-content-black: 238 239 241; /* #eeeff1 */

		/* Content (zinc ramp) — exists only to keep light byte-identical. Collapsible later. */
		--fp-content-zinc: 238 239 241; /* #eeeff1 */

@layer base {

@layer utilities {
	.card {
		/*
		 * border-gray-300 is #d1d5db — a near-white hairline. It sits in a hand-written utility with no
		 * dark override, so every summary box on Exports, Wallet and friends kept a bright border on a
		 * dark page while the Tailwind-classed cards around them went subtle. line-strong IS gray.300,
		 * so light is byte-identical; dark drops to `line` to match those neighbouring cards.
		 */
		@apply rounded-[6px] border border-line-strong p-6;
	}

	.dark .card {
		@apply border-line;
	}

/* Toast notifications — wrap long API/validation messages inside the box */
div[class*='react-hot-toast'] {

	width: auto !important;
	min-width: min(280px, 100%);
	white-space: normal !important;
	overflow-wrap: break-word;

div[class*='react-hot-toast'] > div,
div[class*='react-hot-toast'] > div > div {
	min-width: 0;

	word-break: break-word;
	overflow-wrap: break-word;

/*
 * View Transitions for the header theme toggle.
 *
 * The wipe is declared here rather than driven from JS with element.animate(). Doing it in script
 * means the default animation has to be switched off first, so if the WAAPI call fails to attach for
 * any reason there is no animation left at all and the theme just snaps. As a keyframe the browser
 * owns it, and JS only has to hand over an origin.
 *
 * --theme-wipe-x/y are set to the centre of the toggle before the transition starts; the fallbacks
 * make an un-anchored transition wipe from the middle rather than break.
 */
::view-transition-old(root) {
	animation: none;
	z-index: 1;
}

::view-transition-new(root) {
	/* The new theme sits on top and is revealed; the old one underneath never moves. */
	z-index: 2147483646;
	mix-blend-mode: normal;
	animation: theme-wipe 480ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) both;
}

@keyframes theme-wipe {
	from {
		clip-path: circle(0% at var(--theme-wipe-x, 50%) var(--theme-wipe-y, 50%));
	}
	to {
		/* 150% of the viewport diagonal always clears the furthest corner from any origin. */
		clip-path: circle(150% at var(--theme-wipe-x, 50%) var(--theme-wipe-y, 50%));
	}
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
	::view-transition-group(*),
	::view-transition-old(*),
	::view-transition-new(*) {
		animation: none !important;
	}
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
	.analyzing-prompt-shimmer {
		animation: none;
		color: #374151;
		background: none;
		-webkit-background-clip: unset;
		background-clip: unset;
	}
}
